meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 它会组建一个 5 人小队(3 名漏洞猎手 + 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库,用最小 PoC 验证漏洞是否真能被利用,并按实际可利用性定级,最后给出带结论的报告。
howto.when: 当你提到 “security-research”、“security review” 等关键词,或要求做安全审查、发布前检查时触发;需先启用 team 模式,并给出审计目标(仓库、diff、PR 等)。

say.text: 对这个仓库做安全审计,重点看认证和数据隔离
say.note: 猎手并行排查,再由 PoC 工程师验证

say.text: 审计当前分支相对 merge base 的 diff,找可利用漏洞
say.note: 每条发现按实际可利用性定级

say.text: 只做静态证明,不要真的执行攻击载荷
say.note: 不碰真实服务,用本地样例或干跑

howto.what_en: It spawns a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel, builds minimal PoCs to prove exploitability, rates severity by real exploitability, and ends with a verdict report.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'security-research', 'security review' and similar keywords, or requests for a security review or pre-release check. Needs team mode and a concrete target like a repo or diff.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on this repo, focusing on auth and data isolation
say_en.note: Hunters run in parallel, then PoCs verify findings

say_en.text: Audit this branch's diff against its merge base for exploitable bugs
say_en.note: Each finding is graded by real exploitability

say_en.text: Use static proof only; don't run any real attack payloads
say_en.note: No destructive execution against live systems
